title: Common WAMTA YAML data definitions
description: Reusable $defs that other WAMTA data schemas reference via $ref. Holds shared string patterns and the no-layout-HTML guard mirrored from scripts/validate-data-shape.rb.

markdownText.description: Multi-line markdown-formatted body text. Must not contain layout HTML (use Liquid includes for layout instead).

urlOrPath.description: Either an absolute URL, a site-relative asset path (/assets/...), or another site-relative page link (e.g. /2026/program or events).

assetPath.description: Site-relative path under /assets/. Existence on disk is checked by scripts/validate-data-shape.rb, not by this schema.

yearAssetPath.description: Site-relative path under /assets/years/<year>/. Required for per-year images and PDFs.

isoDate.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date or the literal string TBA. Mirrors validate-data-shape.rb's date_like? check.

noLayoutHtml.description: Forbids layout/script HTML inside string fields. Mirrors FORBIDDEN_HTML in scripts/validate-data-shape.rb. Pattern is case-insensitive via character classes (ECMA-262 regex has no inline (?i) flag).

labelValue.description: A {label, value} pair commonly used for date-like rows where the value can be free-form text (e.g. 'TBA', 'May 30th', or a real date).

linkRecord.description: A clickable link with a display label.

section.description: A {title?, body, map?} content block used by venue, submission, and similar long-form pages.

title.description: Optional section heading. Empty string and null both render without a heading.

body.description: Markdown-formatted section body. Empty string is allowed (e.g. for spacer sections).

mapEmbed.description: Google Maps (or compatible) embed iframe parameters.
